user_gate.observed: Phone screenshot showed an active LIVE ring underneath the still-open onboarding slab; the slab consumed the lower viewport and mode controls. The same frame showed TARGET MOSS and GATE EMBER without an intelligible mechanical explanation.
user_gate.consequence: Treat onboarding/occlusion and cell-family semantics as one direct-usability defect before further conceptual expansion.

recovered: Prior Fold//Bloom mobile UX work had already identified oversized overlays occluding controls.
Screenshot + engine recovery show EMBER/WATER/MOSS are LIVE cell type aliases, not scene/world names.
Type 0/1/2 render as triangle/circle/square and partition the ring into three anchor/cascade memory families.
DEEP/TRANCE/WOOD/VOID are the separate presentation-world vocabulary.
PLAY 0.5 moved mode meaning into the central ring, allowing redundant phone detail panels to recede.
delta: Raise MODE / RELEASE / WORLD action bar above transient play UI.
Make non-actionable HUD and overlay regions pointer-transparent.
Hide redundant HEX detail panel on phone; central ring remains the state witness.
Move DUET controls above the action bar and capture only the +/- buttons.
Convert result/Ecology choice overlays on phone to bounded sheets above the action bar.
Explicit ?play= modes synchronously kill/hide onboarding before active play; no active-ring + onboarding-slab mixed state.
Add runtime hit-test witness data-fb-primary-controls=clear|occluded and browser-smoke coverage at 430×900.
Primary WORLD vocabulary is DEPTH / PULSE / GRAIN / SPARSE while retaining internal DEEP/TRANCE/WOOD/VOID provenance.
Primary cell-family vocabulary is △ TRIANGLE / ○ CIRCLE / □ SQUARE; EMBER/WATER/MOSS remain legacy aliases in old receipts only.
Cache-bust CSS/JS/module edges so the phone receives the interaction and naming fixes.
laws: Active play and onboarding are mutually exclusive surfaces.
Transient chrome may capture touches only where it has an actionable control.
Duplicate detail may disappear on phone when the central instrument already carries the state.
WORLD is presentation only; cell FAMILY is topology identity only.
Do not invent elemental semantics for EMBER/WATER/MOSS.
current_truth: EMBER / WATER / MOSS are legacy aliases only. Primary LIVE UI is △ TRIANGLE / ○ CIRCLE / □ SQUARE; WORLD is DEPTH / PULSE / GRAIN / SPARSE presentation only.
